name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Fishing Rod Holder
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality wood, ensuring durability and long-term use.
    - Constructed 4 parts with a sturdy multi-layer wooden structure (5mm thickness each layer) for enhanced strength:
                  +) Upper Wall Mount Panel: 2-layer wood structure.
                  +) Upper Bar: Single-layer wood.
                  +) Lower Wall Mount Panel: Single-layer wood.
                  +) Lower Bar: 2-layer wood structure.
    - Includes metal L-brackets, screws, and anchors for secure wall installation.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 15 in x 12 in ~ 38.1 x 30.48 cm.
    - Included 8 screws with a diameter of 6mm.
    - Screw length: 5mm.
    - L-bracket size: 20 x 20 mm, hole diameter: 5mm, width: 6mm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - Supports double-sided printing for all pieces except layer 2 of panel 1.

 

  • Installation Instructions:
    - Step 1: Prepare all included parts, including wooden panels, screws, L-brackets, and anchors.
    - Step 2: Assemble the wooden holder panels in the correct positions according to the product structure.
    - Step 3: Attach the L-brackets to the holder for added wall-mount support and stability.
    - Step 4: Mount the rod holder securely onto the wall using the included screws.
    - Step 5: Place fishing rods carefully into the holder.
    📌 Note: Fishing rod not included.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a fishing rod holder and a personalized decorative wall display.
    - Designed to help organize and store multiple fishing rods neatly and securely.
    - Suitable for mounting in garages, fishing rooms, cabins, workshops, or storage areas.
    - Helps save space while keeping rods accessible and well arranged.
    - Perfect for everyday storage, display collections, or themed fishing décor.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, husbands, grandpas, brothers, friends, and fishing lovers.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, retirements, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for anglers, outdoor enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys personalized garage or hobby décor.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for home organization and fishing gear display.
    - Great for holiday gifting, man cave décor, and custom hobby-themed spaces.
    - Adds a practical, personal, and memorable touch to any fishing setup 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Fishing Rod Holder

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
